designThesis: Night-watch instrument, not product marketing UI: first screen is the full logging work surface — form and passage ledger on one continuous fog-grey band inside a near-black shell. Direction (inbound|outbound) is the only structural drama; signal amber is reserved exclusively for offline and validation faults.
subjectGrounding: Passage Log Console; harbour masters logging vessel passages; desktop web app; primary action log a passage (vessel name, inbound/outbound, timestamp, berth note); states empty log, validation error, success row, offline banner; allowed fact Ctrl+Enter; brand near-black shell, fog grey panels, signal amber warnings only, operational short labels; imageless; density 8, motion 1, aesthetic boldness 3.
composition: Full-width desktop instrument: top status rail (title + offline banner slot); primary work band = log form (vessel, direction, time, berth note, Log passage + Ctrl+Enter); ledger band below = chronological rows. ASCII wireframe in NATIVE.md. Not hero/features/KPI dashboard.
informationHierarchy: 1) Log form (required fields + primary action) 2) Offline/validation signal layer 3) Passage ledger (empty invitation → success rows). No decorative metrics or logos.
typography: IBM Plex Sans for UI labels/controls; IBM Plex Mono for vessel names, timestamps, IN/OUT marks with tabular figures. Scale desktop density-8: label 12 / body 14 / row 13 mono / section 16 medium. No display/poster face.
colourAndMaterialModel: shell #0B0C0E; panel #1A1D22; panel-edge #2A2F38; ink #E6E8EC; ink-muted #9AA3B2; signal-amber #E5A00D warnings only. Inset fog panels in near-black shell. No purple/fintech gradients, no acid-green/vermilion decorative accent.
imageryAndAssetStrategy: Deliberately imageless — UI chrome and type are the content; asset manifest none.
interactionConcept: Primary journey open form → fill required fields → save via Log passage or Ctrl+Enter → success row in ledger. Motion intensity 1: essentially static; focus/error outlines only; reduced-motion does nothing extra. Empty/validation/offline/success states as specified in pack.
signatureElement: Direction as two-state lock (Inbound|Outbound) segmented control — the only bold control; ledger rows echo IN/OUT in mono.
primaryRisk: Near-black shell is brand-required and overlaps a common AI default (dark + neon accent); if amber leaks into brand decoration or a third accent is added, the plan collapses into generic dark-tech UI.
implementationGuidance: Implement from NATIVE.md compact plan exactly: six colour tokens only; Plex Sans+Mono roles; full-width form+ledger instrument; direction-lock signature; amber only for offline banner and field errors; no KPIs/logos/illustration; density 8 / motion 1 / boldness 3; visible focus and Ctrl+Enter.
unknowns: Exact validation rules beyond requiredness; berth-note length limits; timestamp source (manual vs system clock); auth/session model; multi-user concurrency; persistence/sync when returning online; non-desktop breakpoints beyond quality floor.
